hook: Your Hindi, Tamil, Telugu and Bengali greetings are flying through space.
title: Indian Languages Are Flying Through Space
description:
The Voyager Golden Record carries greetings in 55 languages, including Hindi, Tamil, Telugu and Bengali. It also holds Indian classical music by Kesarbai Kerkar. The Voyager probes launched in 1977 and carry it into interstellar space.

#Shorts #Space #Voyager
